definition: Conjunction means equality of X and Y values in both indexed background contexts. Nontrivial requires X to take both values. This binary co-occurrence abstraction deliberately omits Hume’s temporal succession; the temporal test supplies distinct ordered times separately.
note: Explicit analytical interface for issue #270. Source support and its limits are separately recorded in the linked source claims and docs/hume-regularity.md. Stronger metaphysical identifications require further argument.
